reviewScope: Lane B Pearl line-level stock-head fallback review

summary.decision: No Pearl line-level stock-head fallback rules are approved at this time.
summary.reason: Available evidence does not sufficiently confirm both stock batter and stock resonant/snare-side head models at the official Pearl/OEM level for these line groups.

companyLevelDecision.reason: Pearl does not have enough consistent official/OEM stock-head evidence across the candidate set to justify a company-wide fallback rule.
notes: Prior Lane B Ludwig/Pearl decision already blocked Pearl for company-wide fallback.
Pearl requires line-level or model-level source confirmation before fallback rules can be considered.
